title: Derived functors of adjoint functors are adjoint
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories $D(\mathcal A)$, $D(\mathcal B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be additive functors with $G$ left adjoint to $F$. Say the right derived functor $RF$ is defined at a complex $K$ of $\mathcal A$ if the ind-system $(F(K'))_{K\to K'}$ of $D(\mathcal B)$, indexed by the quasi-isomorphisms $K\to K'$ in the homotopy category $K(\mathcal A)$, satisfies [def-pc-essentially-constant-ind-diagram] with value $RF(K)$; dually, $LG$ is defined at a complex $M$ of $\mathcal B$ if the pro-system $(G(M'))_{M'\to M}$ over the quasi-isomorphisms $M'\to M$ in $K(\mathcal B)$ satisfies [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram] with value $LG(M)$. If $RF$ is defined at every complex of $\mathcal A$ and $LG$ at every complex of $\mathcal B$, then $RF:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and $LG:D(\mathcal B)\to D(\mathcal A)$ are functors with $LG$ left adjoint to $RF$: there is a canonical bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(LG(M),K)\cong \operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,RF(K))$, functorial in both $K\in D(\mathcal A)$ and $M\in D(\mathcal B)$.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derived_adjunction_of_essentially_constant {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [Category.{vA} A] [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} B] (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ A) [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (adj : G ⊣ F) (hR : ∀ K : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ), let W := HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) let D := MorphismProperty.Under.forget W ⊤ K ⋙ Under.forget K ⋙ F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ∃ X : DerivedCategory B, IsEssentiallyConstantIndDiagram D X) (hL : ∀ M : HomotopyCategory B (ComplexShape.up ℤ), let W := HomotopyCategory.quasiIso B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) let D := MorphismProperty.Over.forget W ⊤ M ⋙ Over.forget M ⋙ G.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ∃ X : DerivedCategory A, IsEssentiallyConstantProDiagram D X) : ∃ (RF : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B) (LG : DerivedCategory B ⥤ DerivedCategory A) (β : F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF) (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LG ⟶ G.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh), RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor β (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧ LG.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso B (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧ ∃ d : LG ⊣ RF, ∀ (M : HomotopyCategory B (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (K : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (f : (G.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M ⟶ K), d.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj M) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) (α.app M ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map f) = DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((adj.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homEquiv M K f) ≫ β.app K
